description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandawala, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001 (24/0070)
categorisation: The gazette content deals exclusively with land-related matters, specifically the determination and publication of land valuations under the 1998 Land Valuation Act. It contains detailed tables with land lot numbers, measurements, valuations, and ownership information for specific land parcels in various districts. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, valuation, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural modifications.
